name: Envelope letter
what: An envelope slides in, its wax seal pops off, the flap opens and a letter rises out and comes to the front with its handwritten lines appearing - an invitation, a thank-you, an announcement.

learned_from.what: an envelope opening and a letter sliding out

motion: slides in 18 f; seal pops 8 f; the flap opens 14 f (rotationX); the letter rises 20 f (slow end) and comes forward; lines 8 f apart
